name: Stalking Love Koi no Hajimari wa Ryakudatsu de
original_name: ストーキングラブ　恋の始まりは略奪で
source:
Having unrequited love for Yamada Ichiro, the protagonist decides to get plastic surgery in order to attract his attention.
By chance, a detective teaches her the fundamentals of covert investigation.
With her new skills, she discovers that Ichiro is actually a con artist who tricks women into marrying him.
As she becomes depressed, all sorts of cute guys come into her life...
She then finds a new goal for herself: to steal them away from their girlfriends. What will become of the protagonist as she wholeheartedly stalks these handsome men?!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/505070]Steam[/url]]
translation:
主人公单恋山田一郎，为了吸引山田一郎的注意而决定接受整容手术。
一次偶然的机会，一位侦探教给她秘密调查的基础知识。
凭借新技能，她发现一郎实际上是一个骗子，欺骗女性嫁给他。
当她变得沮丧时，各种可爱的男人闯入她的生活……
然后她为自己找到了一个新目标：把他们从女朋友身边偷走。一心追随这些美男的主角会变成什么样子？！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/505070]Steam[/url]]
